I do not sell your data, use it for automated decisions or send you marketing emails unless you ask for them.

Who receives the data

Service providers that process data on my behalf under a data processing agreement:

  • Stripe (card and stablecoin payments)
  • Cal.com (call scheduling)
  • Tally (intake form)
  • Google Workspace (email and document storage)
  • Cloudflare (website hosting and anonymous statistics)
  • [invoicing software] (invoicing)

Some of these providers are based in or may transfer data to the United States. Those transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where the provider is certified, or on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

Payments on public blockchains

A USDC payment on Stellar is recorded on a public blockchain that anyone can read. That record cannot be changed or deleted by me or by you. I only link your wallet address to your identity in my own invoicing records.

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct, erase, restrict or port your data, and object to processing, by writing to hello@402scope.org. You can also withdraw any consent at any time. If you think your rights have not been respected, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) at www.aepd.es.
